description: Add navigation loading states to all booth flow pages using React 19 useTransition. After FEAT-001 fixes the dev server, there will still be legitimate 2-5 second compilation delays for cold routes. Show visual feedback (disabled buttons, loading text) during these delays so users know the app is responding. This is a batch change applying the same pattern to 5 pages: idle, consent, frames, capture, preview.
steps: Import useTransition from 'react' in app/(booth)/page.tsx (idle page)
Use isPending to disable tap area and show loading feedback
Repeat same pattern in app/(booth)/consent/page.tsx for both handleAccept and handleDecline
Repeat in app/(booth)/frames/page.tsx for handleConfirmSelection (preview overlay buttons)
Repeat in app/(booth)/capture/page.tsx for handleNext (after third photo captured)
Repeat in app/(booth)/preview/page.tsx for handleConfirm (Cetak button)
Test each navigation manually in dev mode to verify loading states appear during compilation
acceptance_criteria: All booth navigation buttons disable during router.push() execution
Buttons show visual feedback (opacity or loading text) when disabled
Navigation still completes successfully after the pending state
No type errors from TypeScript compiler
No layout shifts or visual glitches during transitions
verification: Run pnpm typecheck to verify TypeScript passes
Run pnpm dev:web and navigate through entire booth flow: / → consent → frames → capture (3 photos) → preview → composing
On each navigation, verify button shows disabled state during compilation
Verify navigation completes normally after loading state clears
